Name: PolySwarm
Author: PolySwarm - support@polyswarm.io
Description:
[PolySwarm](https://polyswarm.io) is a threat intelligence platform built on a marketplace of competing detection engines. Files, URLs, IP addresses and domains are analyzed by multiple engines in parallel, their consensus is scored as a single PolyScore, PolyUnite identifies the malware family, and sandbox detonation adds behavioral analysis. This solution enriches Microsoft Sentinel incident entities (file hashes, URLs, IP addresses and domains) with PolySwarm's multi-engine malware verdicts, naming every engine that agreed, and lets an analyst detonate a URL, an email attachment, an Azure Storage blob, or a file retrieved directly from a device through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, in the PolySwarm sandbox, returning a score-derived verdict, malware family, MITRE ATT&CK techniques and a report link on the incident. Data connectors bring PolySwarm threat intelligence, from an organization's own PolySwarm hunt results and from the PolySwarm curated feed, into Microsoft Sentinel's native threat intelligence table, so Microsoft's built-in indicator matching runs against PolySwarm data alongside the analytics rules and hunting queries this solution provides.

Coverage by indicator type: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, URL, domain and IP are answered. Email addresses are not supported, because PolySwarm has no endpoint for them. A small PolySwarm status workbook shows what has arrived from each connector, reading only your own workspace.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:
This solution depends on underlying Microsoft technologies. Some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:
* [Logic Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/logic-apps/logic-apps-pricing)
* [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)
* [Threat Indicators](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/upload-indicators-api)
* [Key Vault](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/general/pricing)
